keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «땅속의 녹은 암석이 올라와 화산이 생긴다(주제)» 와 «화산은 아주 오랜 시간에 걸쳐 천천히 자란다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (volcanoes form when melted rock pushes up to the surface) and the conclusion (a volcano grows slowly over a very long time). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.qen: What is the most important fact?

boxes.a: Layers of lava and ash form a mountain

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

opts: Because it is lighter than the solid rock around it
Because it is colder than the rock around it
evs: Because magma is lighter than the solid rock around it, it slowly rises.
This melted rock is called magma.
Once magma reaches the surface, people call it lava.
In this way, a volcano grows slowly over a very long time.
why: 마그마는 주변의 단단한 암석보다 가볍기 때문에 천천히 올라온다고 했어요.
Magma rises because it is lighter than the solid rock around it.

qs.q: In «the magma bursts out through cracks,» what does «bursts out» mean?
qs.qko: «the magma bursts out through cracks» 에서 «bursts out» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: stays still for a long time
evs: When the pressure becomes too strong, the magma bursts out through cracks in the surface.
Deep inside the Earth, it is so hot that some rock melts.
It often collects in a large space under the ground called a magma chamber.
After many eruptions, layers of cooled lava and ash build up and form a mountain.
why: 압력이 너무 강해졌을 때 일어나는 일이니, «bursts out» 은 힘차게 «갑자기 터져 나온다» 는 뜻이에요.
It happens when the pressure becomes too strong, so «bursts out» means comes out suddenly and strongly.

qs.q: How does magma from deep underground become part of a mountain?
qs.qko: 땅속 깊은 곳의 마그마는 어떻게 산의 일부가 되나요?
opts: It reaches the surface as lava, then cools and builds up in layers
It sinks deeper and turns into water
It stays in the magma chamber forever
evs: Once magma reaches the surface, people call it lava.
This melted rock is called magma.
After many eruptions, layers of cooled lava and ash build up and form a mountain.
It often collects in a large space under the ground called a magma chamber.
why: 마그마가 지표에 나오면 용암이 되고, 식은 용암과 화산재가 층층이 쌓여 산이 돼요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Magma becomes lava at the surface, and layers of cooled lava and ash build up to form a mountain. You need both sentences.

ends: Why do some volcanoes sleep for many years?
왜 어떤 화산은 오랫동안 잠들어 있을까?
Why are so many volcanoes around the Pacific Ocean?

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because I want to see lava)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because I want to see lava)
write.src: “I want to <u>see a real volcano</u> because <u>I want to watch lava move</u>.”
